description: Build an agent project into a single self-contained executable '<project folder name>.bot' (the botcore runtime plus the project's manifest.md, agent.md, skills/, tools/doc/ and tools/bin/ appended read-only). Validates tools first and reports errors and warnings. Use dry_run=true to only validate. The project and the output must be inside the working directory. No compiler is involved.

dir.description: Agent project directory, relative to the working directory. Default: the working directory itself.

output.description: Output file path inside the working directory. Default: ./<name of the project folder>.bot

dry_run.description: Only validate the project, write nothing. Default false.
